notes.title: The Game is Going Free – Help Shape Its Future!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]East Defense is Going to be free to play for a limited time![/b]
This decision comes from our desire to [b]expand the player base[/b] and gather as much feedback as possible to ensure the game grows in the right direction.[/p][p]During this free period, we ask for your support by [b]sharing your thoughts, reporting bugs, and suggesting features or improvements.[/b] Your voices will directly shape the development of the game moving forward.[/p][p]Once we’ve gathered enough feedback and refined the game, it will return to being a paid title at a [b]reasonable price[/b]—but everyone who joins us during this stage will have made a lasting mark on its future.[/p][p]We’re already working on an exciting update that will include:[/p][list][*][p][b]More levels and custom levels[/b] for with new designs and ideas[/p][/*][*][p][b]A brand-new game mode: Village Building[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New monster types[/b] to challenge your strategies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deeper strategy elements[/b] in the additional upcoming levels[/p][/*][/list][p]This is your chance to jump in, explore, and help us craft the best experience possible.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey—let’s build something amazing together![/p][p]– A Devs.[/p]
